scope: Bundled ledger fixture: transfer and retry contract
summary: Keep the public Ledger contract and intentional SQLite adapter seam. The inspected workflow does not justify an architectural refactor.

workflows.name: Transfer ledger units
workflows.promise: A valid transfer moves units atomically; an exact retry returns the original receipt and a conflicting retry is rejected.

trace.role: own local transaction, request identity, balances, and receipt

workflows.owner: Ledger owns input validation; SQLiteLedger owns persistence guarantees. This split is intentional.

invariants.statement: An exact retry moves balances once and a changed amount with the same request ID is rejected in the in-memory SQLite tests.
A missing receiver rolls back the debit and leaves no receipt in the tested boundary.
Concurrent requests across separate database connections preserve the contract.

unknowns: PostgreSQL implementation is outside this fixture
The fixture suite does not exercise concurrent connections

checks.details: Executed from evals/fixtures/ledger on 2026-11-21: 5 tests passed. This is a recorded fixture result, not a promise about every future environment.

unverified: Concurrent connections in the shipped fixture suite

next_step: No architectural change recommended in the inspected scope. If concurrent writers are in scope, add a separate-connection integration check before claiming that guarantee.
